acceptance_criteria.criterion: Log preview entries display human-friendly labels instead of raw action names (e.g., "Starting the run" instead of "run_start").
`tool_call` entries include the tool name when `entry.tool_name` is present (e.g., "Tool call: ledger_help").
`tool_call` entries without a tool name display "Tool call" (graceful fallback).

All action types listed in the plan's mapping table (step 5) produce the specified label: `run_start` → "Starting the run", `stage_start` → "Starting stage: {stage}", `stage_complete` → "Stage complete: {stage}", `progress_snapshot` → "Progress snapshot", `tool_call` → "Tool call: {tool_name}", `wp_complete` → "Work package complete: {wp_id}", `wp_status_change` → "WP status → {new_status}", `run_end` → "Run ended", `run_error` → "Run error", `signal_shutdown` → "Interrupted by signal", `heartbeat` → "Heartbeat", `mcp_error` → "MCP error", `route` → "Routing decision".
Unknown/unrecognised action types produce a title-cased version of the raw action or fall back to showing the JSON.
The progress badge (`renderProgressBadge`) is NOT changed — it continues to use the raw action string.
